description:
About Pragma & FirstLook 
 Pragma & FirstLook are building the modern operating system for game development, trusted by over 2,000 game studios, including Square Enix, Sony, EA, Krafton, Scopely, Brain Jar Games, and more.
 FirstLook (including creators.gg and player.gg) is the industry leading Player CRM that helps studios and publishers onboard, understand, and retain their players throughout a game's entire lifecycle - from first playtest to live operations. We've onboarded millions of players and power community growth for 2,000+ studios.
 Pragma Engine is the game industry leading backend - cross-platform authentication, social, commerce, player data, matchmaking, telemetry, and more. Works as your backend or with your existing backend.
 You'll be joining a deeply experienced team who have scaled some of the largest games in the world, including League of Legends and Destiny 2. Our team also brings platform experience from Google, Twitch, Amazon, and Microsoft.
 We are a Series B company backed by globally renowned technology investors, including Greylock, Insight Partners, and Upfront Ventures.
 Location: Remote, based in Europe or North America
 Coverage: Strategic accounts across North America and Europe, with APAC support during overlapping hours
 Employment: Full time
 About the Role 
 This is a commercial role for someone who knows games and can sell custom solutions to studios and publishers. You'll learn FirstLook inside out, run the demos yourself, build the proposals, and help close and grow our biggest accounts.
 As a Strategic Account Manager, you'll work with our largest and most strategic studio and publisher partners across North America and Europe. This is a hybrid role. Half of it is pre-sale: partnering with our sales team on in-depth demos, discovery, proposals, and custom solutions for strategic deals. The other half is post-sale: owning a portfolio of enterprise accounts, making sure they get real value from FirstLook, and growing those relationships through new licenses, add-ons, and campaigns.
 Our enterprise customers rarely buy something off the shelf. They run white label playtests, managed creator programs, paid player acquisition campaigns, and custom setups. You'll be the person who figures out what a studio actually needs, designs a solution that fits, helps close it, and then makes sure it delivers. This is a high-ownership role on a small team, with a direct line to leadership and product.
 This isn't an engineering role. Some technical comfort helps, but the core of the job is relationships, demos, proposals, and closing.
 What You'll Do 
 Solutions & Strategic Deals 
 Partner with sales on strategic opportunities, leading in-depth demos, discovery, and solution design
 Scope and build proposals for custom solutions, including white label playtests, managed creator programs, player acquisition campaigns, and integrations
 Translate studio goals into practical plans with clear deliverables, timelines, and success metrics
 Act as the product expert in deal cycles, answering complex questions and handling objections
 Ensure a smooth handoff from sale to onboarding so nothing gets lost between the deal and delivery
 Customer Success & Account Growth 
 Own relationships with a portfolio of strategic enterprise studios and publishers
 Lead onboarding, success planning, and regular business reviews tied to measurable outcomes
 Drive expansion through additional licenses, add-ons, and campaigns, and own renewals for your accounts
 Identify opportunities to grow within studios and publishers, working with sales to reach new teams and titles
 Monitor account health and usage, flag risks early, and own the follow-through
 Bring structured customer feedback and product needs to Product and Engineering
 Team & Scale 
 Help shape how we deliver custom solutions as the business grows, turning repeat work into repeatable playbooks
 Support and backstop teammates on strategic accounts, and help support APAC accounts during overlapping hours
 Keep account plans, opportunities, and next steps current in our CRM
 Requirements 
 Experience 
 6+ years in account management, solutions engineering, partnerships, or business development, ideally at a platform or SaaS company serving game studios or publishers
 Track record of managing large, complex accounts and growing them commercially
 Experience designing and selling custom or consultative solutions, not just standard packages
 Experience owning commercial conversations, including proposals, pricing, renewals, and expansion
 Skills 
 You can learn software deeply and demo it confidently. You don't need an engineering background.
 Equally comfortable in a technical deep dive with a studio's engineering team and in a commercial conversation with their head of marketing or publishing
 Organized and self-directed: you can juggle several strategic accounts and live deals at once without dropping either
 Excellent written and verbal communication in English
 Nice to Have 
 Existing relationships with game studios and publishers in North America or Europe
 Background in player acquisition, playtesting, creator or influencer programs, community platforms, payments, or e-commerce for games
 Experience at a games platform or marketplace working directly with publisher partners
 Additional European or Asian language skills
 Location & Logistics 
 Full time, remote, based in Europe or North America or Canada
 Coverage of strategic accounts across North America and Europe, with support for APAC accounts during overlapping hours
 Willing to work across time zones and travel to industry events and customer sites
 Competitive compensation, including variable compensation tied to account growth. Benefits vary by country and employment arrangement

title: Customer Success Manager I
description:
About Lyra Health 
 Lyra Health is a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. The company has delivered more than 15 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 35 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness, and cost efficiency. Extensive peer-reviewed research confirms Lyra’s transformative care model helps people recover twice as fast and results in a 26% annual reduction in overall healthcare claims costs. Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions. 
 About the Role
 Lyra Health is looking for a Customer Success Manager who is energized by engaging with customers, building relationships and delivering results.
 You should be highly organized, detail-oriented, and resourceful. This role will be a great fit for you if you are a doer; you are passionate about making a difference, comfortable with ambiguity, and are naturally collaborative.
 Responsibilities
 Serve as the primary relationship owner for MM employer customers (1,000-5,000 lives), partnering closely with customer benefit teams and key stakeholders.
 Manage renewals and partner with Account Executives to identify expansion opportunities, ensuring customers feel supported and delighted, and are retained year over year.
 Support customers’ utilization goals through value-driven, data-led business reviews (QBRs/ABRs) and ongoing meetings.
 Monitor account health proactively to identify churn or operational risks through efficient reporting.
 Leverage AI and modern technology tools to scale workflows, optimize day-to-day execution, and guide peers on process improvements.
 Collaborate cross-functionally with product, clinical, data science, and legal teams to resolve issues and present a unified front.
 Master multiple Lyra product offerings to effectively champion new features and maximize customer adoption.
 Partner with marketing to deliver engaging communication campaigns and workshops for your customers.
 Proactively re-evaluate day-to-day priorities to maintain focus during departmental shifts or evolving workflows.
 Qualifications
 5+ years of experience in customer success or a related field, ideally within HR, employee benefits, or healthcare.
 Experience managing employer accounts with headcounts within the 1,000-5,000 range (or similar mid-market complexity).
 Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in fast-paced environments and navigate ambiguity with autonomy.
 Strong commercial acumen with direct experience managing renewals and driving customer utilization metrics.
 Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with a track record of gaining trust quickly and using data storytelling to influence stakeholders.
 Ability to leverage AI and software tools to automate tasks, optimize workflows, and drive operational efficiency.
 Strong project management skills and the ability to collaborate successfully across cross-functional teams.
 A growth mindset and a passion for mental health and changing the healthcare landscape.
 Willingness to travel (10%).

 By applying for this position, you acknowledge that your personal information will be processed as per the Lyra Health Workforce Privacy Notice. Through this application, to the extent permitted by law, we will collect personal information from you including, but not limited to, your name, email address, gender identity, employment information, and phone number for the purposes of recruiting and assessing suitability, aptitude, skills, qualifications, and interests for employment with Lyra. description:
A career that’s the whole package!
 At Conga , we’ve built a community where our colleagues can thrive. Here you’ll find opportunities to innovate and support growth through individual and team development, all within an environment where every voice is heard.
 Conga lines up commercial operations so companies run as connected, smarter businesses. By unifying the people and processes that drive commerce, Conga aligns pricing, quoting, contracting, rebates, and communications so teams stay in sync and buyers keep moving forward. The result is trusted decisions, consistent buyer experiences, and profitable growth. More than 10,000 customers worldwide, including over 50% of the Fortune 100®, trust Conga when commercial complexity is high and global impact is on the line.

 Conga ’s customers are industry leaders who rely on us to power their revenue operations at scale. As a Customer Success Manager, you’re not just supporting accounts, you’re shaping strategic outcomes for national and global enterprises. Your work directly impacts customer retention, expansion, and satisfaction, making you a key driver of Conga ’s growth. This is a high-visibility role where your ability to build trust, influence adoption, and deliver value will make a measurable difference.

 Project management proficiency: Demonstrated ability to lead complex, cross-functional customer initiatives from planning through execution. Skilled at defining objectives, coordinating stakeholders, managing timelines, dependencies, risks, and action items, and maintaining accountability to drive initiatives toward measurable outcomes.
 Business acumen : Able to align product functionality and adoption to broader business goals, interpreting or creating these in partnership with your customers Confident in advising on best practices, backed by a solid understanding of revenue models, KPIs, and financial metrics relevant to the customer’s industry. 
 Customer advocacy: Passion for advocating on behalf of customers, representing their interests, and influencing internal stakeholders to deliver customer-centric solutions. Dedication to ensuring customer satisfaction, loyalty, and long-term partnerships.

description:
Manager of Client Implementation 
 Virtual Peaker is looking for a Manager of Client Implementation that will help solve the climate crisis by supporting our mission of building the utility of the future. 
 Job Description
 The Manager of Client Implementation will lead the implementation of new program and product launches with Virtual Peaker clients. Your primary focus will be to deliver programs and products accurately, on time, and with seamless handoffs. Because Virtual Peaker manages grid-responsive DER such as batteries, electric vehicle charging, smart HVAC and water heating, and other emerging technology as critical resources for the electric grid, the successful candidate will be focused, proactive, and customer-centric. You will plug into a high-performing team and must thrive in a fast-paced environment. Strong EQ and comfort with ambiguity are required. 
 Role Responsibilities
 Support end-to-end implementation of program launches and expansions for Virtual Peaker clients.
 Serve as a point of escalation during implementation, building trusted relationships.
 Manage and mentor a team of implementation staff, setting expectations and providing feedback.
 Improve implementation processes and documentation.
 Own implementation KPIs. 
 Other relevant and appropriately scoped duties as assigned that contribute to Virtual Peaker ’s success.
 Education & Experience
 An ideal candidate will have the following:
 Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution required 
 5+ years of professional experience in software implementation, SaaS onboarding, or technical project management.
 Experience in program development and management, ideally within a B2B SaaS or technology environment.
 Understanding of utilities, clean energy and grid modernization issues, including DERs. 
 Strong organizational skills, including project management, process design, and cross-functional coordination.
 Ability to travel as needed 
 What to expect
 Full remote position, with remote-work stipend. 
 Competitive salary + Equity
 A collaborative workplace, which will challenge you and celebrate your work
 Full benefits medical, dental, vision, 401k
 Generous vacation time, sick leave, and holidays
 Diverse and inclusive community for everyone
 Interested?
 Virtual Peaker is currently a small remote-first team tackling huge problems, and that means that everyone, from the interns on up, are critically important to our mission. If you want to be a bit player on a huge team thinking about micro-optimizations, this role is definitely not for you. If you want to take responsibility for changing the outcome of human civilization, we want to hear from you.
 Competitive Salary
 Benefits: stock options, generous 401k, remote-first stipend, and health, dental, and vision insurance.
 Location: Remote

title: Technical Customer Success Manager
description:
At Cube, we're redefining how organizations deliver, consume, and automate data and analytics across teams, tools, and AI agents. Our mission is to enable Agentic Analytics, where AI agents work alongside humans on a shared semantic foundation.
 If you're fascinated by building core data and AI infrastructure, the kind that powers analytics at the world's most advanced technology companies, but want the agility and ownership of a startup, Cube is where you'll thrive.
 With 19,000+ GitHub stars and 13,000+ community members, Cube is trusted by 400+ companies, including Maersk, Kimberly-Clark, Freshworks, Patagonia, Webflow, Brex, Deel, Tubi, Walmart, and Drata. Our platform empowers AI agents with a universal semantic foundation, enabling autonomous analytics at scale while maintaining consistency, security, and performance across BI tools, spreadsheets, and embedded applications.
 We're looking for a Technical Customer Success Manager who can operate at the intersection of data engineering and business strategy. This is not a traditional CSM role where you send check-in emails and track NPS scores. You'll be the strategic partner for a portfolio of customers, helping them get real value from Cube, diagnosing technical problems, running QBRs with data leaders, and making sure they renew and grow. The "technical" in the title is real: our customers are data engineers, analytics engineers, and engineering leaders who talk in SQL and think in data models, and they evaluate you on whether you actually understand their stack. This role reports to the Head of Customer Success.
 What you will do:
 Own customer outcomes. Manage a portfolio of mid-market and enterprise accounts end to end, from onboarding through renewal, accountable for implementation, retention, adoption, and expansion.
 Run strategic QBRs that go beyond usage dashboards: analyze deployment health, surface adoption gaps, build ROI narratives, and give customers a clear roadmap for getting more value from Cube.
 Get technical: understand how customers have modeled their data in Cube, diagnose performance issues (pre-aggregation strategy, query optimization, caching behavior), and advise on best practices.
 Be the voice of the customer internally, translating feedback into product insights and working with engineering, product, and solutions architecture to resolve issues.
 Drive adoption of new capabilities such as Analytics Chat, embedded agentic analytics, MCP integration, workbooks, and dashboards.
 Manage renewals and identify expansion opportunities, owning the commercial relationship alongside our sales team.
 Who you are:
 5+ years in a customer-facing role at a data, analytics, or developer-tools company (CSM, technical account manager, solutions consultant, or similar).
 Strong SQL skills: you can write queries with window functions, CTEs, and cohort logic, and read someone else's SQL and spot what's wrong.
 Experience working with technical stakeholders (data engineers, analytics engineers, engineering managers) and executive stakeholders (VP/Head of Data, CTO) in the same account.
 A track record of managing renewals and driving account growth in a SaaS environment.
 Ability to run a QBR that a data leader would actually find valuable: business narrative, not just metrics.
 Familiarity with the modern data stack: cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks), transformation tools (dbt), and BI/analytics tools.
 Excellent written and verbal communication: you can explain a pre-aggregation strategy to a data engineer and explain ROI to a VP in the same meeting.
 Based in the US with availability for overlap with US business hours.
 Bonus points:
 Experience with Cube or semantic layer concepts (metrics layers, governed data models, headless BI).
 Background in analytics engineering, data engineering, or BI, having been on the practitioner side.
 Familiarity with embedded analytics use cases and multi-tenant architectures.
 Experience with API-first or developer-tool products where the buyer is technical.
 Understanding of AI/LLM integrations in the data stack (MCP, text-to-SQL, agentic workflows).
 Comfort with light data modeling, YAML/code-based configuration, or git workflows.
 This role is customer-facing and involves occasional travel to customer sites and company events.
 We're a fully remote company based in San Francisco, hiring for this role in the United States. You can work from anywhere in the US and join our highly collaborative team.

title: Customer Success Manager, Scale
description:
Your impact 
 Own a portfolio of growing eCommerce brands. Data and AI show you where to focus. You help merchants get more value, stay longer and grow with us.
 We're building Customer Success differently. You won't spend your day checking accounts by hand or preparing summaries. Our systems and AI tools surface changes in usage, adoption, risk and opportunity for you. So you can focus on the conversations that help Shopify merchants succeed, and turn that value into retention and growth. This is a commercial role for someone with customer-facing experience who wants to grow fast in SaaS, eCommerce and AI.
 Your portfolio will tell you things like:
 A merchant's product usage has dropped sharply.
 A key feature hasn't been adopted after onboarding.
 A merchant is getting strong value, but another Clearer product could solve an obvious problem for them.
 A once-active merchant has gone quiet.
 A merchant has reached the point where a different plan or product makes more sense.
 Your job is to read the signal, work out what matters and act. Data tells you where to look. AI helps you move faster.
 What you'll do
 Drive customer outcomes
 Identify what each merchant is trying to achieve, and connect their product usage back to those goals.
 Help merchants adopt the features and workflows most likely to create value.
 Spot where merchants are stuck, underusing the product or not getting the value they expected.
 Run focused consultations that always end with a clear next step.
 Re-onboard or redirect merchants when their original setup is no longer working.
 Track whether adoption is improving, not just whether a meeting happened.
 Retention and expansion
 Monitor changes in usage, engagement, customer health and commercial behavior.
 Prioritize accounts by how likely churn is, and how much it would matter.
 Understand why a merchant is disengaging before you decide how to step in.
 Run save and recovery conversations.
 Own expansion across your portfolio. Spot upgrade and cross-sell opportunities, like a better-fit plan or another Clearer product that solves a real problem, and turn them into revenue.
 Use AI tools every day to prioritize your accounts, prepare for conversations and act faster.
 Success isn't about activity. It's about whether merchants use the product, get value and stay.
 What you'll bring
 Strong experience in a customer-facing role, such as customer success, account management or sales
 Experience with Shopify or the wider eCommerce ecosystem
 Confidence in commercial conversations, from renewals and saves to upgrades
 Comfort using data to decide where to focus and what to do next
 Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
 A proactive, collaborative, customer-first mindset
 Experience in a scaled, high-volume Customer Success model
 Hands-on use of AI tools in your day-to-day work
 Don't tick every box? Apply anyway. We hire for potential and mindset as much as experience - if this role excites you, we want to hear from you.
 life at clearer.io
 eCommerce is crowded, noisy and increasingly complex. At clearer.io, we're built for a different outcome: clarity you can act on.
 We connect to the stack a merchant already uses. Our AI agents enrich their catalogue, learn from their reviews and customers, and put that intelligence to work inside the tools they already own — so their products get found, trusted and chosen by shoppers and AI, without replatforming. We do this across our products: Clearer, Boost Commerce, REVIEWS.io and Influence, used by thousands of merchants worldwide.
 We're a global team with offices in Australia, the UK, Germany, Vietnam and the US, backed for the long term by PSG Equity and Silversmith Capital Partners.
 We care about doing the work properly: listening first, building second and shipping quickly where it matters. Results matter more than rhetoric.
 What guides us day to day:
 Customers at the heart: we obsess over their needs so we can grow together
 Purposeful progress: we don't settle - we take initiative and embrace bold thinking
 Endless innovation: we refine, improve, and take meaningful action
 Always open: we build trust through transparency and global collaboration
 clear benefits
 Medical, dental and vision coverage
 401k
 20 days PTO, plus paid holidays and sick leave
 Paid parental leave
 Your birthday and a Give Back Day off each year
 a fair shot for everyone
 We're committed to a fair and inclusive hiring experience. Hiring decisions at clearer.io are based on skills, experience and role requirements - nothing else. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just tell us; it won't affect your application.
 Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered in accordance with the California Fair Chance Act and applicable local ordinances.
 If you believe eCommerce growth should be simpler, smarter and clearer - we'd love to hear from you. Apply now.

title: Customer Success Advisor, Commercial
description:
Are you ready to be a trusted advisor helping commercial organizations transform operations and realize measurable value from their technology investments? 
 At Naviant , our mission is to partner with organizations to reimagine how work gets done, combining deep industry expertise, intelligent technology, and a human-centered approach to deliver measurable outcomes.We serve as the Agentic Partner for the modern enterprise, leading deep business transformation by building autonomous, intelligent solutions that enable executive leaders to transform and optimize their entire operating model. Our vision is simple yet ambitious: Reimagine work through automation, AI, and data, freeing people to focus on what truly matters.
 We’re seeking a Customer Success Advisor with a Commercial Industry focus, supporting clients in manufacturing, supply chain, and related operationally complex environments. This role is ideal for a relationship‑driven professional who understands how technology enables efficiency, scalability, and compliance, and who thrives at the intersection of customer advocacy, operational insight, and long‑term value creation.
 As a Customer Success Advisor, you will build trusted partnerships with clients, serve as their internal champion, and guide them toward maximizing ROI through strong adoption, measurable outcomes, and strategic alignment. You’ll collaborate closely with internal delivery, support, and sales teams to ensure customers are successful today while positioned for future growth.
 Performance Objectives – What You Will Accomplish 
 First 30 Days: Getting Grounded 
 Develop a strong understanding of Naviant ’s solutions, services, and how they support commercial industry workflows such as manufacturing operations, supply chain management, compliance, and process efficiency.
 Learn assigned customer environments, business objectives, KPIs, and success criteria.
 Establish initial relationships with customer stakeholders and internal cross‑functional teams.
 Begin monitoring customer health indicators, adoption trends, and engagement patterns.
 Demonstrate credibility through clear communication, responsiveness, and a customer‑first mindset.
